subject: Regional hub bridge + ops backstop for AtlasBridge console/API onboarding
messages:
From: Ellie Grant <ellie@atlasbridge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Quick: EU hub onboarding — multi-team invite

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo earlier. We want to get a focused onboarding for our EU platform and ops teams next week — a console walkthrough + API enablement, with a short hands-on lab for our SREs. Our team spans London, Berlin, and Amsterdam, so timezone-friendly windows are ideal.

Preferred days: Dec 21 or Dec 22. Prefer mornings CET (09:30–12:30 CET). Expected attendees: 10–12 (mix of product, SRE, and security).

Two asks up front: can we split into a 60‑minute console overview + 90‑minute API lab (split into two contiguous blocks), and can you provide a short prework doc so we can provision service accounts and sandbox keys?

Appreciate a quick slot proposal — our PM (platform@atlasbridge.com) is looped.

Best,
Ellie
Ellie Grant
Head of Integrations, AtlasBridge

--

Option A — Tue Dec 21
• 09:30–10:30 CET: Console overview (with Q&A)
• 10:45–12:15 CET: API enablement + hands-on lab

Option B — Wed Dec 22 (same blocks)

Operational notes:

• Prework: short checklist for service account + sandbox creds — I can send that now.
• We'll provide a quick runbook and a calendar invite with separate dial-ins for the hands-on portion.

Are you ok with Option A? If you confirm today I’ll loop in Camila for the console deep-dive and Ben to own the lab.

Team — quick coordination for AtlasBridge (customer picked Dec 21). Ellie asked for a split 60/90 session in the morning CET (09:30–12:15 CET). Can you cover the following?

Camila — console walkthrough lead (09:30–10:30 CET). Focus areas: RBAC, private deployment options, and per-route cost breakdown in Console.
Ben — API lab lead (10:45–12:15 CET). We'll run their engineers through token flows, sandbox keys, KV cache behavior, and a short batching exercise.
Monica — ops backup and chat escalation owner (standby during the lab; help with sandbox provisioning if needed).

Attachments: redwood_onboard_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), console-checklist.xlsx (prework checklist). Please review the runbook and confirm you can take the blocks. I'll send invites once you confirm.

Thanks — Connor
